items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔完美利用了自己一手造成的舆论风暴扮演受害者
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔对裁判判罚的公开批评，正是其精细化管理和战术布局的一部分。
bodyZh: 绅士从不是无意中显得粗鲁，而全都是刻意为之。没有人真正知道这句话是谁最先说的。但这很可能是出自《精英足球主教练新闻发布会指南》（英超版）中的一句台词。因为在这些场合里，没有任何事情是偶然发生的。
在印满赞助商广告的背景板前说的每一个字，都是经过计量和策划的。主教练绝不会无缘无故地生气、担忧，甚至连展现魅力都不是无意的。比赛就是比赛，但在比赛前后的所有花絮同样也是比赛的一部分。
当听到米克尔·阿尔特塔谈到桑德兰在光明球场获得的点球时，人们很难不去想这一点——当时埃兹里·孔萨被认为对丹·巴拉德有拉拽行为。这是出于真正的职业尊重。正如每个做播客的人都知道的那样——说实话，也就是所有人——在Spotify的某个黑暗角落里，总会有一些失落的亚马逊部落在讨论《女孩》第三季；有些时候，你只需按下开关，提升能量，开启全情投入的真诚模式。
阿尔特塔在那一刻将这一点表现得淋漓尽致，他看起来对自己的言论感到由衷的震惊，散发着一种受伤的正直感，就像一个失望的副校长在呼吁归还学校的小巴钥匙。
不过我们要说清楚。阿尔特塔并不是对这一切感到“非常担心”。他并不“难过”，正如他后来特意强调的那样，也并非“真的很难过”。他不仅是为了“保护比赛”而发声，在这里代表我们所有人，他也仅仅是一个足球迷。
得了吧。我们都知道这位主教练痴迷于最微小的优势，对微观细节进行微观规划。现在的顶级体育运动全都是如此。有传言称，赛艇教练在训练基地安装了玻璃纤维马桶座圈，因为他们计算过平均每个运动员在里面呆20分钟，而这全部是关键的臀肌管理时间。阿尔特塔就喜欢这些。本·怀特绝不可能在训练基地的金标易杯超软疏通王宝座上玩手机。
他的公开声明也是如此。这一切都经过了提前的博弈和应急规划。这是出于硬核、理性、战术上的原因，因为现在的比赛就是这样被运作和掌控的。那么这意味着什么呢？
我们有三件事是可以确定的。首先，阿尔特塔是对的。这是一个糟糕的裁判判罚。最显而易见的是，它在事实上是错误的。巴拉德非常巧妙地把孔萨拉倒在自己身上，同时还假装对这种事情的发生感到震惊。
这个判罚之所以糟糕，还因为裁判的反应是预先策划好的，赛季初关于以更具干涉主义的方式进行判罚的讨论就给出了信号。带着某种既定想法进入任何情境，去完成一项措辞模糊的使命：这会扭曲你的判断。
第二件事是，裁判并不是带有偏见。他们只是水平不够高。他们身上发生了两件事。首先，在比赛期间实时需要吸收的信息量简直令人匪夷所思。
大多数裁判并非出身于高压数据处理背景。他们不是军用飞行员，也不是外汇交易员。不到四分之一的人拥有大学学位。这项任务超出了他们的能力。这不是诋毁或侮辱。这是对正在发生的事情的简单描述，并且有证据支持。
这之所以加倍令人恼火，是因为裁判们对自己的角色产生了根本性的混淆。裁判不是马戏团团长，也不是奇观的策展人。他们无权决定我们的足球运动应该是什么样子。职业裁判公司是一家私人公司，没有法定地位来裁决足球的美学。裁判应该存在于奇观的最边缘。你不是地方政府规划官员，没有授权去决定哪些双层玻璃法式门才符合社区的风格。别再把足球搞砸了，而且是错得离谱。
但阿尔特塔对此也做好了准备。阿森纳的教练们会知道这种情况迟早会发生。新闻发布会上那番回应已经在酝酿之中了。阿尔特塔甚至可能练习过他那种难过但不生气的表情以及他的核心台词。
而这将会是正确的做法。这些都没有违反规则，就像阿森纳不是一支粗野的球队或是一群骗子一样。他们只是在按照现有的规则踢球，这项运动目前正被逼在自身极其微观分析的规则边缘运行，处理的只是一些关于身体接触的小问题。
阿尔特塔的阿森纳在寻找这方面的优势时堪称大师。现在的后卫非常擅长用脚控球。挑选后卫并不是为了让他们具备抵抗身体对抗的能力。利用这一点是合乎逻辑的，正如通过公开谈论规则如何应用来保护自己利用这一点的能力也是合乎逻辑的一样。这就是为什么阿尔特塔很优秀，也是为什么他能赢。
订阅每日足球
用卫报的足球视角开启您的傍晚
时事通讯推广之后
同样真实的是，这创造了一种奇怪的环境。更广泛的阿森纳球迷群体的基调也是这里的另一个因素。没有哪一种单一类型的足球球迷。所有人都在这里。但事实依然是，阿森纳网络群体中最嘈杂的声音，甚至球场内的氛围，在其对受害者心态、阴谋论以及一种激昂的逆境感的绝对确信上，都是独一无二的。
没有哪个球场像这里一样，每一个裁判判罚，甚至是那些未知的五五开判罚，都会遭到如此激烈和雄辩的质疑。有些支持者似乎在比赛的大部分时间里都站着，处于一种表演式的、武器化的愤慨状态中，他们与比赛的全部互动都带着一种受委屈的不满态度。
这也说得通。它直接呼应了我们所创造的比赛。满腹牢骚的中年规则学究。这就是仇恨的新大熔炉。
这有现实依据吗？也许从表面数据来看并没有。本赛季阿森纳被判的犯规次数比其他任何球队都多。上赛季只有六支球队被判的犯规次数比他们多，前一年也是如此。他们上赛季得到的黄牌最少。自从在2024-25赛季吃到六张红牌以来，他们还没有拿过一张红牌。
尽管如此，某些关键事件继续让人感到烦心和发酵。在阿斯顿维拉对阵布鲁诺·吉马良斯的比赛中，本该判给他们的点球被错误地剥夺了。2023年对阵布伦特福德时VAR划线的乌龙事件——如果这真的是蓄意作弊的阴谋，那将是有史以来策划最糟糕、最公开的蓄意阴谋作弊。
人们对某些规则似乎对阿森纳执行得更严厉感到不满，比如拖延时间或在重新开球时搞小动作等这些愚蠢的小事。话又说回来，如果你把比赛的重点放在那上面，如果你计划在边缘地带踢球并取得了成功，那么当你这样做的时候，那个地方可能会发生更多的事情。
阿尔特塔也非常熟练地扮演了远程愤怒操纵者的角色，从很少对裁判发表评论转变为进行真诚且目标明确的批评。判给桑德兰的点球是第一次机会，让他得以宣泄对阿森纳战术的裁判反弹，发起他事先准备好的辩护，并指出一个显而易见的事实：裁判已经失去了对局面的控制，因为比赛已经超出了他们的掌控。
在许多方面，这对阿尔特塔来说是一场完美的风暴。不仅是一个无关紧要的判罚（因为点球被扑出了），而且是一个明显不正确的判罚，这是一个在自己显然占理时进行游说的机会。
随着赛季的进行，这种情况还会更多，因为阿森纳正努力保持他们在近距离战术攻防中为自己赢得的优势。考虑到在新闻发布会上那次大师级的指控，周六的这场胜利在不止一个方面具有重大意义。

items.titleEn: Arteta on a "tough" night at Molineux
items.summaryEn: Get the view from the boss following our Premier League game against Wolves
bodyEn: After seeing us draw at Wolves, Mikel Arteta admitted that our second-half display cost us dear at Molineux.

We were 2-0 ahead against the Old Gold thanks to goals from Bukayo Saka and Piero Hincapie, but the home side fought back with a stunner from Hugo Bueno before a late own goal from Riccardo Calafiori saw two points slip away.
And Mikel felt that our performance after the break proved costly as we allowed our opponents back into the game to battle hard for a point.

“We’re very disappointed with the end result, but I think we have to fault ourselves,” Mikel said. “I think the performance in the second half doesn't show the level and the standards required in the Premier League to win in the manner that we should have won the game, especially in the way that we played in the first half.

“It's very tough, we are frustrated because it's down to us. It's time to talk on the pitch because anything that we say right now comes from anger, frustration, disappointment, and there's nothing coming through that is going to benefit and help the team going forward.

“It's nothing to do with attitude or with desire. There were a lot of things that went wrong in the second half that didn't allow us to have any dominance, even though we scored the second goal. We never felt that we were in control of the game.”
Attention now turns to Sunday’s north London derby at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, and a chance to get back to winning ways in the Premier League.
Mikel is keen to allow the dust to settle after this one before urging his squad to bounce back by getting the victory we crave against our old rivals

“We need to improve, pick ourselves up, bring the energy back,” he added. “Now we have a great game on Sunday to show that.“I think we owe ourselves that one after what we've done today in the second half. I think we need some time, a few hours to digest. This one has to be a really, really painful one and we use it in the right way to improve.”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔谈莫利纽球场的“艰难”之夜
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔谈论了阿森纳在英超战平狼队后的看法。
bodyZh: 在目睹球队被狼队逼平后，米克尔·阿尔特塔承认，我们在下半场的表现让我们在莫利纽付出了沉重代价。
凭借萨卡和皮耶罗·欣卡皮耶的进球，我们一度以2比0领先狼队，但主队随后由雨果·布埃诺轰出一记世界波扳回一城，接着里卡尔多·卡拉菲奥里在尾声阶段自摆乌龙，导致三分变一分。
米克尔认为我们在中场休息后的表现付出了惨痛代价，因为我们让对手重回比赛并为一分苦战。
“我们对最终的结果非常失望，但我认为我们只能怪自己，”米克尔说道。“我认为下半场的表现没有达到英超所需的水平和标准，无法以我们本该有的方式赢得比赛，尤其是我们在上半场的踢法。”
“这非常艰难，我们感到沮丧，因为这完全是我们的责任。现在需要在球场上用表现说话，因为我们现在说的任何话都源于愤怒、沮丧和失望，没有任何言语能对球队接下来的发展起到积极和帮助作用。”
“这与态度或求胜欲无关。下半场有很多事情出了问题，让我们无法占据任何统治地位，尽管我们打进了第二个球。我们从未感觉到自己掌控了比赛。”
现在注意力转向周日在托特纳姆热刺球场进行的北伦敦德比，这也是在英超重回胜利轨道的机会。
米克尔希望在平息这场比赛的情绪后，再激励球队在对阵老对手时拿下渴望的胜利以实现反弹。
他补充道：“我们需要改进，振作起来，恢复能量。现在我们在周日有一场大战来证明自己。我认为在经历了今天下半场的表现后，我们欠自己一个交代。我们需要一些时间，几个小时来消化。这场比赛必须是非常非常痛苦的，我们要以正确的方式利用它来取得进步。”

items.titleEn: Rice: "Everyone’s needed on this road to the end"
items.summaryEn: Get the view from the away changing room following our Premier League game against Brentford
bodyEn: Declan Rice feels that when we look back on our 1-1 draw against Brentford in the coming months, we might feel that the point we left west London with was a good one.

An excellent Noni Madueke header got us in front during the second half at the Gtech Community Stadium but we were pegged back when Keane Lewis-Potter equalised 10 minutes later, and despite an end-to-end rip-roaring conclusion, either side could have finished victorious.

But both had to settle for a share of the spoils, and despite being frustrated we couldn’t quite hang onto all three points, Declan feels that given the opposition’s performance this season and the context of the game, he’s happy to look on the positive side during a feel-good campaign so far.

“We weren’t naive to think that this was going to be a pushover,” he said. “They’re an amazing team, they’re seventh in the league and Keith Andrews has got them playing really, really well. They're so effective at how they play, and we prepared for that. We knew what was coming.

“It might be a valuable point towards the end. The only thing we can do is just keep worrying about ourselves like we’ve been doing. We’ve been on an amazing run this season, the performances have been incredible. If you look at the amount of games we’ve played and how many we’ve won, we’ve lost three in all competitions all season.
“So let’s take the positives, keep going, keep pushing, keep sticking together. Everyone’s needed on this road to the end. There’s a long way to go but we’re positive.”
A goalless first half with minimal goalmouth action gave way to a helter-skelter affair after the break, and Dec feels that the result was a fair one given each side dominated portions of the game.

The draw means our lead at the top of the table has been cut to four following Manchester City’s win against Fulham 24 hours earlier, but we can park our Premier League dreams for a few days now as we refocus on the FA Cup and a home game against Wigan Athletic on Sunday.

“It was a really tough game,” Rice reflected. “They probably had the first 20 minutes, we then probably had the next 25 and ended the first half really well. Then we started the second half really well, got the goal which was fully deserved, and then they probably had the last 25 minutes. So it was split into different stages, and could have probably gone either way at the end. “We really wanted to win, we wanted to stamp our authority on it, but in the end we have to take the point and move forward.
“We have to keep going. We’ve played a lot of games this season, and we’ve got to keep staying mentally refreshed, physically refreshed. Now we move on to the next game, so got to keep going.”

items.titleZh: 赖斯：通往终点的这段旅程需要每一个人
items.summaryZh: 赖斯谈客平布伦特福德，认为这是一个宝贵的积分。
bodyZh: 德克兰·赖斯认为，当我们在未来几个月回看这场对阵布伦特福德的1比1平局时，我们可能会觉得从西伦敦带走的这1分是个不错的成果。
在Gtech社区球场进行的下半场比赛中，马杜埃凯精彩的头球破门帮助我们取得领先，但10分钟后基恩·刘易斯-波特扳平了比分，尽管随后的比赛精彩纷呈且高潮迭起，但双方都有可能带走胜利。
不过双方最终只能握手言和。尽管未能全取三分让人感到遗憾，但考虑到对手本赛季的表现以及比赛的背景，德克兰表示，在这个整体感觉不错的赛季中，他乐于看到积极的一面。
他说：“我们并不是天真地认为这会是一场轻松的比赛。他们是一支伟大的球队，在联赛中排名第七，基斯·安德鲁斯让他们踢得非常非常出色。他们的踢法极具效率，我们为此做好了准备。我们知道会发生什么。”
“到最后这可能是一个宝贵的积分。我们能做的就是像之前一样，继续专注于我们自己。我们本赛季经历了一段美妙的旅程，表现令人难以置信。如果你看看我们踢了多少场比赛以及赢了多少场，我们全赛季各项赛事只输了三场。”
“所以让我们看到积极的方面，继续前进，继续努力，紧密团结在一起。通往终点的这条路上需要每一个人。还有很长的路要走，但我们充满信心。”
上半场互交白卷且门前险情不多，下半场则演变成了一场节奏飞快的比赛，赖斯认为考虑到双方各自统治了一段比赛时间，这个结果是公平的。
由于曼城在24小时前击败了富勒姆，这场平局意味着我们在积分榜榜首的领先优势被缩小到了4分。不过，我们可以先把英超梦想放在一边几天，重新将注意力集中到周日主场对阵维甘竞技的足总杯比赛上。
赖斯回忆道：“这是一场非常艰难的比赛。他们可能占据了前20分钟，然后我们可能掌控了接下来的25分钟，并且以极佳的状态结束了上半场。接着我们下半场开局很好，取得了完全当之无愧的进球，随后他们可能占据了最后25分钟。所以比赛被分成了不同的阶段，最后结果鹿死谁手尚未可知。我们真的很想赢，我们想要确立统治地位，但最终我们只能接受平局并继续前进。”
“我们必须继续前进。我们本赛季踢了很多比赛，我们必须在精神和身体上保持活力。现在我们要专注于下一场比赛，所以必须继续前进。”

items.titleEn: Every word from Arteta's post-Brentford presser
items.summaryEn: Find out what the boss had to say to the media in attendance at the Gtech Community Stadium after our Premier League clash
bodyEn: We left west London with a point after being held to a 1-1 draw against Brentfod and after the game, Mikel Arteta spoke with the press.
Noni Madueke headed us in front before Keane Lewis-Potter levelled for the Bees at the Gtech Community Stadium.
Here's everything Mikel had to say in his press conference:

on the result:Well, I think the game had different moments. The first 10-15 minutes we lacked certain composure to dominate the game better. I think after that we started to play much more in our way and started to play in their half and generated some good situations without really having clear-cut chances. The second half, the way we started, we really looked to threat. The way we combined, the way we threat constantly their backline and the goalkeeper, it was much better. Again, without really hitting the target enough times or finishing enough actions, and then we scored the goal and the game was under total control.

But against them, that's not enough, because they just need somebody making a foul that is unnecessary. A ball in the channel, they push you. The clearance is not good, ball goes for a throw-in. Then you have to pray, because they are exceptional at what they do. The chaos that is in and around that ball is very, very difficult to defend, and we said, you want to win here, you're going to have to defend the box with your life, and you're going to have to clear the ball, because there's a lot of people there, and if you don't do that, it's very difficult for you to win the game. We haven't done it in one of the actions. Credit to them as well for that, and then the game became more open, more transitional. They had one of the big chances and the clearance of Declan [Rice] just at the end, and we have two very good counters and probably the biggest chance of the game when Martinelli is 1v1 with the keeper to win it.

on if Martinelli had to score:You have to. It's football and the keeper as well can make the decision and the action that he did. But if you want to win here, you're going to have to be really ruthless in both boxes, and today we lacked that.

on the reason for the half-time change:Because with the way, especially that they were pressing, I think we needed another kind of profile to generate many more problems for them around those areas, and I think he [Odegaard] came on in the pitch really well and the team had another gear and more threat to arrive to the areas that we wanted to do and that decision.

on if he’s worried about Eze:Well, I think he had moments and it's not easy when you move to a new club. It's always like this, and when you play against a team that is like this and the ball is a lot of times not on the floor and you have to be constantly breaking the play and do that, especially for attacking and creative players, it's more difficult.

on playing after Manchester City:I think we played as well after them a few times this season and we have won the games. Today is not about that. Today we lacked certain things against them. You have to defend those situations, even better, prevent them. You want to give them no chance or just hope that something bad happens. We didn't manage that well enough for us probably.

on if he takes a positive from the game:It has to be every action, because they go for volume. They know the probability of what they want to create and they need volume to increase that probability. They are constantly doing that - and they’re really good at doing that.

on Brentford’s style:They’re really good, because when they have to play it around as well, there are so many areas in their high press where they are really good. They are exceptional when they have to counter, as well. They have a lot of qualities, and credit to them. They can take the game into the areas, they are really well coached, and from the beginning I said credit to them for what they do - because they don’t have the home record and aren’t in the position they are in the league [without it], that’s for sure.

on staying calm:That’s what we have to do. I mean, we’re going to be willing and preparing to win every single match, and the only thing we can do is focus on that. We need to raise the levels, collectively and individually, to be better than the opponent every week. That’s going to carry on like this until May. They’re the things we have to do, and that’s the most important thing.

on the title race:I understand [the points gap could be bigger], but that’s ‘if, if, if’. If we’d lost at Newcastle, we’d have been eight points behind Liverpool in October. So, ‘if, if’, there are a lot of ‘ifs’ over 10 months in this competition. You can only focus on what you have to do, and try to do that in the best possible way.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赛后采访全记录
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳在英超客场战平布伦特福德，阿尔特塔赛后接受采访。
bodyZh: 在Gtech社区球场与布伦特福德战成1-1平后，我们带着一分离开西伦敦，赛后米克尔·阿尔特塔接受了记者采访。
马杜埃凯头球破门帮助我们取得领先，随后基恩·刘易斯-波特在Gtech社区球场为主队扳平比分。
以下是米克尔在赛后新闻发布会上的全部发言：

关于比赛结果：嗯，我认为比赛有不同的阶段。前10到15分钟，我们缺乏一定的冷静来更好地控制比赛。我认为在那之后，我们开始更多地按照我们的方式踢球，开始进入他们的半场，创造了一些不错的情况，但并没有真正获得绝佳机会。下半场一开始的踢法，我们确实打出了威胁。我们的传切配合、对他们后防线和门将持续不断形成的威胁要好得多。同样，我们在门前没有足够的射门次数或完成足够的进攻终结，然后我们进球了，比赛完全在我们的掌控之中。

但对阵他们时，这还不够，因为他们只需要有人制造一次不必要的犯规。边路的传球，他们就会压迫。解围没做好，球出了边线。然后你只能祈祷，因为他们在做的事情上非常出色。围绕着这个球的混乱局面非常非常难防守，我们说过，如果你想在这里赢球，你必须用生命去防守禁区，你必须把球解围出去，因为那里有很多人，如果你不这么做，你想赢得比赛就非常困难。我们在其中一次防守中没有做到这一点。这也归功于对手，随后比赛变得更加开放，转换更多。他们有过一次绝佳机会，德克兰（赖斯）在最后时刻完成了门线解围，我们也有两次非常好的反击，马丁内利面对门将形成单刀可能是本场比赛最好的制胜机会。
关于马丁内利是否必须进球：你必须进球。这就是足球，门将也可以做出他所做出的决定和动作。但如果你想在这里赢球，你必须在两个禁区内都非常冷酷无情，而今天我们缺乏这一点。
关于半场换人的原因：因为考虑到他们的逼抢方式，我认为我们需要另一种类型的人员配置，在这些区域给他们制造更多麻烦，我认为厄德高替补登场后表现非常出色，球队提升了一个档次，在我们想要到达的区域创造了更多威胁，这就是那个决定的原因。
关于是否担心埃泽：嗯，我认为他有过一些亮眼表现，当你转会到一家新俱乐部时这并不容易。情况总是如此，当你对阵这样一支球队时，球很多时候都不在地上，你必须不断地打断比赛，尤其是对于进攻和创造型球员来说，这更加困难。
关于在曼城之后比赛：我认为本赛季我们在他们之后比赛过好几次，并且我们赢下了比赛。今天与此无关。今天我们在对阵他们时缺乏某些东西。你必须防守好那些情况，甚至做得更好，去阻止它们。你不想给他们任何机会，或者只是希望坏事发生。我们可能没有把这一点处理得足够好。
关于是否能从比赛中看到积极的一面：每一次进攻都必须如此，因为他们追求的是进攻的厚度。他们知道自己想要创造的机会的概率，他们需要通过增加厚度来提高这种概率。他们一直在这样做——而且他们在这方面真的非常擅长。
关于布伦特福德的风格：他们真的很强，因为当他们需要组织传导时，在前场高位逼抢中有那么多区域他们做得非常好。当他们需要打反击时，他们也极其出色。他们有很多特质，这要归功于对手。他们能把比赛带入他们想要的区域，他们被调教得非常好，从一开始我就赞赏他们所做的一切——因为如果没有这些，他们不可能拥有这样的主场战绩，也不可能处于目前的联赛排名，这是肯定的。
关于保持冷静：这就是我们必须要做的。我的意思是，我们将全力以赴并做好准备赢得每一场比赛，我们能做的唯有专注于此。我们需要在集体和个人层面上提升水平，每个星期都要比对手表现得更好。这种情况将一直持续到五月。这些都是我们必须做的事情，也是最重要的事情。
关于争冠形势：我理解（积分差距可能会更大），但这就是“如果、如果、如果”。如果我们在纽卡斯尔输球，我们在十月份就会落后利物浦八分。所以，在这项长达10个月的赛事中，有太多的“如果”。你只能专注于你必须做的事情，并尝试以尽可能最好的方式去完成它。

items.titleEn: Arteta gives update on Saka, Odegaard and Merino
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has issued a fitness update on Bukayo Saka, Martin Odegaard and Leandro Trossard ahead of our trip across London to take on Brentford on Thursday.

The boss is managing a squad across a packed fixture schedule with numerous players sidelined, including Bukayo Saka and Martin Odegaard, as well as Leandro Trossard going off in our win over Sunderland.
During Wednesday afternoon’s press conference in preparation for our game at the Gtech Stadium with Keith Andrews' side, Mikel has delivered an update.
“[Bukayo, Martin and Leandro], we will see,” he said.

Max Dowman has been rehabilitating from an injury, having last appeared in a competitive first-team match in November, when he became our youngest-ever Champions League appearance-maker against Slavia Prague.
Mikel has admitted the 16-year-old is still not quite ready yet, but is making considerable strides towards a future return.
“Max is still not available. However, he’s doing very well.
“I think he will be with us in a week or so, and then he can pick up the rhythm and be available for us.”
Lastly, our manager discussed Mikel Merino, who underwent foot surgery earlier this week, beginning an extended period of recovery which will last several months.
Merino had been enjoying a very productive campaign, scoring 12 times for club and country including in his last appearance against Manchester United at Emirates Stadium.
“I think the doctors were really happy with the way [the surgery] went,” he explained.
“Now it’s the start of obviously a long process, we’re talking about bone healing. So, we’ll respect the timings, and I’m sure he’s going to do everything he possibly can to speed up that recovery.
“The timeframes, we’re talking about months - whether it’s three, four or five, we don’t know.”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔更新萨卡、厄德高和梅里诺的情况
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔在赛前新闻发布会上更新了伤病情况。
bodyZh: 阿尔特塔在球队即将前往伦敦客场挑战布伦特福德之前，公布了萨卡、厄德高和特罗萨德的身体状况。
主教练在赛程密集且多名球员缺阵的情况下管理着球队，其中包括萨卡和厄德高，以及在战胜桑德兰比赛中离场的特罗萨德。
在周三下午为客场对阵布伦特福德比赛做准备的新闻发布会上，阿尔特塔给出了最新消息。
关于萨卡、厄德高和特罗萨德，他表示：“我们将拭目以待。”
马克斯·道曼一直在进行伤病康复，他上一次在成年队正式比赛中登场是在11月，当时他对阵布拉格斯拉维亚时成为了队史最年轻的欧冠出场球员。
阿尔特塔承认这位16岁的小将目前还没有完全准备好，但正在为未来的复出取得长足进展。
“马克斯目前还无法出场。不过，他恢复得很好。”
“我认为他大约一周后就能归队，然后找回比赛节奏并为我们出场。”
最后，主教练谈到了梅里诺，后者本周早些时候接受了足部手术，开始了长达数月的漫长康复期。
梅里诺本赛季表现出色，为俱乐部和国家队攻入12球，其中包括在酋长球场对阵曼联时的进球。
他解释说：“我认为医生对手术的进展非常满意。”
“现在显然是一个漫长过程的开始，我们讨论的是骨骼愈合。所以，我们会尊重时间表，我确信他会竭尽全力加快康复。”
“关于时间框架，我们说的是几个月——无论是三个月、四个月还是五个月，我们目前还不知道。”

items.titleEn: Martinelli in Colney Carpool, at Emirates Stadium!
items.summaryEn: Take a look at when Frimmy's infamous buggy turned up at Emirates Stadium to give our Brazilian attacker a ride around
bodyEn: Gabriel Martinelli is the latest player to star in our Colney Carpool series, but this episode is a little different - it's not at our training ground...
Frimmy's lifts around London Colney have proven so popular, that when Gabriel Martinelli needed a ride around Emirates Stadium, there was only one man he could call upon!

The duo drove around our famous pitch singing songs and telling jokes, and surprising a tour group in the process who were shocked to see their hero up close and personal! Then they retreated into the stands to discuss Gabi's favourite moments at our home, and what it's like being a supporter.
Before completing his ride, Gabi discussed zombie apocalypses and his favourite English snack - his choice might surprise you!
Watch all the fun by pressing play on the video above.

items.summaryZh: 来看看弗里米的 buggy 车是如何开到酋长球场带我们巴西前锋兜风的。
bodyZh: 加布里埃尔·马丁内利成为最新一位出演我们科尔尼拼车秀的球员，但这一期有点不同——它不在我们的训练基地……
弗里米在伦敦科尔尼的载人出行大受欢迎，因此当加布里埃尔·马丁内利需要有人带他在酋长球场兜风时，他只能找这个人！
两人开着车绕着我们著名的球场唱歌、开玩笑，并在此过程中给一个参观团带来了惊喜，他们震惊地近距离看到了自己的偶像！随后他们退到看台上，讨论加比在我们主场最喜欢的时刻，以及作为一名球迷是什么感觉。
在完成他的兜风之旅前，加比讨论了丧尸末日以及他最喜欢的英式零食——他的选择可能会让你大吃一惊！
